summary: Regression PASS on all 7 deployment-fix items. Backend starts cleanly (importers.py `import os` in place, no import errors in supervisor log). Pytest regression suite: 7/7 green (test_regression_deploy_fix.py) — GET /api/events 200, GET /api/sources 200, admin login 200, GET /api/admin/partners 200, GET /api/admin/events 200, GET /api/admin/analytics/overview 200, GET /api/auth/me returns role='admin'. Frontend (mobile 390x844) verified via Playwright after seeding lux.langPicked/lux.onboarded to bypass onboarding: (1) /business — Field sub-component (which now calls useAppPalette() itself) renders all 6 fields (biz-name, biz-venue, biz-email, biz-website, biz-ig, biz-fb) + biz-submit and heading 'For businesses'; filling works. (2) /admin — admin-login-card + admin-email + admin-password + admin-submit render; login with admin@familyluxembourg.lu / <redacted> succeeds and redirects to /admin/events (verified /admin/events page loads with 276-total events list). (3) /admin/partners — statusStyle(s, palette) signature change verified: 2 PENDING badges render with computed background rgb(254, 243, 199) = #FEF3C7 amber (correct pending color). (4) /admin/analytics — the Stat sub-component (now with its own useAppPalette hook) renders 4 stat cards (Total events / Published / Drafts / Featured) plus the 3 requested cards 'All-time views', 'Monthly featured revenue', 'Top events by views'. (5) /admin/sources — sources list + Add-new-feed form renders (src-new-name, src-new-url, src-new-canton, src-add, src-kind-ical, src-kind-ckan all visible). Note: an in-page error banner 'Unexpected token I, Internal S... is not valid JSON' appears because GET /api/admin/sources returns 500 — this is a PRE-EXISTING backend bug (a seeded source doc has kind='visit_luxembourg' which is not in the SourceResponse Literal), NOT caused by the deployment fix; the form itself renders correctly. (6) /admin/events/new — LangField sub-component (now scoped to file) renders EN/DE/FR fields for title, short, description; toggle-published and edit-save render. No pageerrors observed; only one console error corresponding to the pre-existing /api/admin/sources 500. Deployment-fix regressions are all clean.
